panel: 35 (three fixes), and every `.duo-card h3 small` that contains => or other operators
what: The engine sets `.duo-card h3 small` in JetBrains Mono, but it isn't `code`, so the ligature switch-off doesn't reach it: `() => stage.announce()` and `announce = () => …` are drawn with a single ⇒ glyph, which a beginner can't type.
evidence: comic-widgets.css:237 `.duo-card h3 small { font: 700 0.95rem var(--f-code) }`; comic.css:351/354 turn ligatures off only for code/pre/samp/kbd/.anatomy/svg text and widget classes. Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/z3.png (from /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a17/w390-061-p35.png). The same markup pattern (=> etc. inside `h3 > small`) also occurs in javascript/ch5, ch7, ch9, ch11 and ch27.
fix: comic.css:354 `:is(code, pre, samp, kbd, .anatomy, svg text)` → `:is(code, pre, samp, kbd, .anatomy, svg text, .duo-card h3 small)` (or a general `[style*='--f-code'], .mono` hook). Why: any text drawn in the mono font must show the characters the reader types (house rule).

what: The token `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor` in a recap card has no break point and runs past the card's right border, cut off as `Object.getOwnPropertyDes`.
evidence: Crop /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/z5.png (from /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a19/w1280-080-p45.png). comic.css:268 `.recap li` has no rule for long inline code. The 11:15 integration pass added `overflow-wrap: break-word` for code in `.caption, .bubble, .narration, .readlist li, .checklist li`, but not `.recap li`.
fix: In the integration-pass rule `:is(.caption, .bubble, .narration, .readlist li, .checklist li) :is(code, samp) { overflow-wrap: break-word }` → add `.recap li` and `.duo-card p` to the list. Why: recap cards are narrow (min 200px) and the JS books name long APIs there.

what: New evidence for INTEGRATION_TODO 'Terminal wrapping consistency': at 390 almost every plain `.term` in js ch16-20 scrolls sideways (216 of them, 66 to 749px), and in the short ones the only hidden text is the prompt's command, so the reader sees `you@laptop:~/javascript-ch17$ node` with no file name.
evidence: Audit counts (pre.term scrolling at 390): ch16 16, ch17 23, ch18 40, ch19 19, ch20 25. Example: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a17/w390-031-p18.png (`node` then output; `big.js` is off screen). The `.term.wrap` terminals on the same pages wrap the prompt under itself.
fix: Engine: give the prompt line a hanging wrap in every terminal, not only `.term.wrap`: `.term .prompt-line { white-space: pre-wrap; padding-left: 2ch; text-indent: -2ch }` (or wrap only the `.tl` that holds the prompt). Why: the command is the one line the reader must copy; output lines can keep scrolling.

what: In the four-beat strip the pager's state words, the only non-colour cue for pending versus fulfilled, render at 8.5px (WAIT, BUZZ!) and its #7 tag at 6.2px on phones (10.2px and 7.4px at 1280). The cover pager's #16 tag is 11px.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/z1.png (right column, from /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a16/w390-019-p10.png); /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a16/w1280-019-p10.png. js-ch16.css:30 `.beat16 .pics .char.pg { width: 74px }` and :66 `width: 62px` at ≤640px; the pager draws WAIT at 22 units in a 160-unit viewBox.
fix: `@media (max-width: 640px) { .beat16 .pics .char.pg { width: 62px } }` → `@media (max-width: 480px) { .beats16 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) } .beat16 .pics .char.pg { width: 110px } }` (WAIT then draws at about 15px). Why: state words must stay readable (12px minimum), because they are what keeps state from resting on colour alone.

what: The backpack's tags, which carry the lesson (greeting = "Hello", mark = "!", seats: a million, NO OWNER), render at 7.6-9.4px on phones and 10-11px at 1280, because the 180-unit drawing is squeezed to 100px in a two-column grid.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/z2.png (from /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a17/w390-006-p3.png and w390-031-p18.png); /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a17/w1280-006-p3.png. js-ch17.css:74 `.props17 .char { width: 100px }` at ≤640px; js-ch17.js:80 shrinks long tags to 12 units (= 6.7px at 100px wide).
fix: `.props17 .char { width: 100px }` (≤640px) → `.props17 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) } .props17 .char { width: 170px }` at ≤480px, and js-ch17.js:80 `Math.max(12, …)` → `Math.max(15, …)` with a wider tag. Why: text that teaches must be 12px or larger on a phone.

what: Code in the prop captions breaks in the middle of a token: `makeGreeter("H` / `ello")` and `intro.call(bo` / `)`.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/z2.png (p3 caption); /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a17/w390-044-p24.png. js-ch17.css:33 `.props17 figcaption code { overflow-wrap: anywhere }`.
fix: Put `<wbr>` after the opening bracket (`makeGreeter(<wbr>"Hello")`, `intro.call(<wbr>bo)`) and change `overflow-wrap: anywhere` → `overflow-wrap: break-word`. Why: a line should break at punctuation, as the engine does in code (DESIGN_SYSTEM §6), not inside a string.

what: At desktop width the side-by-side var/let listings cut off the line that matters, `setTimeout(() => console.log("var lap", i), 0);`, at `console.log("var l`, so the reader has to scroll two small boxes to compare them.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a17/w1280-022-p12.png. `.two-files.side` gives each column about 350px; the line is 48 characters.
fix: `<div class="two-files side">` → `<div class="two-files">` for this panel (stacked listings are 716px wide and show the whole line), or `.two-files.side .code { font-size: 0.8125rem }`. Why: a comparison panel needs both lines fully in view.

what: The browser-console terminal's first line, `open dom_this.html in a browser (console sh…`, is cut off even at 1280; at 390 the terminal scrolls 369px.
fix: `<pre class="term" data-run="dom_this.html">` → `<pre class="term wrap" …>`. Why: the engine's `.term.wrap` gives a hanging indent and keeps carets aligned, so nothing is lost.

what: 38 of the chapter's 40 terminals are plain `.term`, so every long error line scrolls out of view: at 1280 the ReferenceError in panel 44 is cut at `before acces` (493px hidden) and panel 35 hides 203px; at 390 panels 44, 35, 38, 34 and 30 hide 749, 495, 396, 362 and 360px of the message the readlist asks the reader to read first.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a18/w1280-069-p44.png; /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a18/w390-069-p44.png, w390-055-p35.png, w390-059-p38.png. Only 2 `class="term wrap"` in ch18, against 10-23 in ch16, ch17, ch19 and ch20.
fix: `<pre class="term" data-run="super_missing.js" data-fold …>` → `<pre class="term wrap" …>` on every terminal that prints an error (the engine never wraps the caret's source line, so `^` stays aligned). Why: 'read the last line first' only works if the last line is on screen.

what: The hand-drawn pictures keep their 440-unit desktop drawings on phones, so their labels shrink to 10.1-11.5px (toString: ƒ, hasOwnProperty: ƒ, …and 10 more, name:"Ada"). The cover's labels are 9.7-11.6px at both widths.
fix: Give panels 3, 14 and 23 the `.pic18.wide` / `.pic18.narrow` pair that panel 41 already uses, or raise their `font-size` attributes from 13-14 to 16. Why: on a phone, labels inside drawings should be 12px or larger.

what: The three `bow()` machines are drawn at `.sm` (100px), so their plates read 8.2px, and on phones they fall into an uneven 2 + 1 arrangement under the bubble.
fix: Drop `class="char sm"` → `class="char"` and add `.cab-row { gap: 6px }`. At ≤640px, show one machine with a ×30 badge instead of three. Why: a plate that names the method should be readable, and a row of three shouldn't break 2 + 1.

what: The switch panel's ON/OFF words, which the page says carry the state 'never colour alone', render at 9.7-11.1px at 1280 and on phones (cover: 8.2-9.9px), because the 380-unit drawing is capped at 300px wide inside a much wider card.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a19/w1280-008-p4.png (panel about 290px wide in a 716px card); audit small text: p3/p4/p11 ON 10.8-11.1px, OFF 9.7-9.9px. js-ch19.css:31 `.props19 .char { max-width: 300px }`; js-ch19.js:60 font-size 14 / 12.5.
fix: `.props19 .char { width: 100%; max-width: 300px }` → `max-width: 420px`, and js-ch19.js:60 `font-size="(on ? 14 : 12.5)"` → `16` for both (widen the switch rect from 62 to 70 units). Why: the words are the state signal, so they must stay at 12px or more.

what: levels.js prints a padded table (padEnd(17)/padEnd(7)), but the terminal is `term wrap`, so on phones the columns fold: `seal … delete:` / `refused` and `freeze … change: refused delete:` / `refused`. The three locks become hard to compare.
fix: `<pre class="term wrap" data-run="levels.js">` → `<pre class="term" data-run="levels.js">` (it scrolls, and the columns stay aligned). Why: output whose layout is its meaning shouldn't wrap.

what: The hint-name column breaks the three keywords in the middle: `"st|ring"`, `"nu|mber"`, `"de|faul|t"`.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/z7.png (from /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a19/w390-057-p35.png). js-ch19.css:61 `table.hints19 code { overflow-wrap: anywhere }`, and the first column gets about 40px.
fix: `table.hints19 code { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` → `table.hints19 td:first-child code { white-space: nowrap; overflow-wrap: normal }` (keep `anywhere` only for the middle column). Why: the hint names are the words the reader must learn, so they shouldn't split.

what: On the cover the dispenser and coat-check labels are 7.2-8.7px on phones (next(), 'red', done: false) and 8.3-10px at 1280. The WeakMap picture in panel 19 squeezes 'no feathers' to 10.6px.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a20/w390-000-main-after-p0-panel.png, w390-033-p19.png; /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-js-16-20/a20/w1280-000-main-after-p0-panel.png. js-ch20.css:10 `.cover20 .char.dp { width: 150px }` (130px at ≤640px) for a 270-unit drawing.
fix: `.cover20 .char.dp { width: 130px }` (≤640px) → `width: 170px`, and in js-ch20.js `txt(…, 10)` minimum → 13 units for coat and ticket text. Why: a label under 12px reads as noise.

what: The chapter's diagram-like props wrap their whole drawing, labels included, in the engine's `.bob` idle loop, so a table of switches, drawers and tickets the reader is meant to read moves up and down every 2.4s.
evidence: js-ch19.js:33/70/96 and js-ch20.js coatcheck/guestlist/dispenser `var out = '<g class="bob">'`. Verified with Playwright: `bob 2.4s` running at 1280 with motion on; it stops correctly with 'Animations: off' and prefers-reduced-motion.
fix: `var out = '<g class="bob">'` → `var out = '<g>'` for switchpanel, inkcab, coatcheck and guestlist (keep the bob on the face characters: pager, puppet, storyteller). Why (Emil, standard 1): motion needs a purpose. An idle loop on a reference diagram only makes its labels harder to read.

panel: beats16, lanes16, rules17, vent17, props17/19/20 figures, legend19, pipe19, wk19, venn20, flow20
what: Each chapter hand-rolls its own card (3px ink border, `border-radius: 12px`, `box-shadow: 4px 4px 0`) instead of using the engine's `.duo-card` or card tokens, so radii and shadows drift from the system (`--radius-lg` 14px, `--shadow-hard` 3px or `-lg` 6px).
evidence: js-ch16.css:25,46; js-ch17.css:25,37,50; js-ch19.css:26,38,48,63; js-ch20.css:26,40,54. None uses `var(--radius-lg)` or `var(--shadow-hard*)` (grep finds no token use in any of the five files).
fix: `border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink)` → `border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-hard-lg)`, or replace the markup with `.duo` / `.duo-card` plus the tint classes. Why: cards should share one radius and shadow scale (shadcn Card mapping, DESIGN_SYSTEM §3).

what: js-ch16.js redefines `L.cast.pager`, a byte-for-byte copy of the engine's comic-critters.js pager. Because it loads later, it silently overrides any future engine fix to the pager, such as label sizes.
evidence: `diff` of the `L.cast.pager = {…}` blocks in assets/comic-critters.js:548 and assets/ext/js-ch16.js:19 gives identical output; AUTHORING 'pager critter (engine note)'.
fix: Delete js-ch16.js's `L.cast.pager` block (the file then holds only its header) and drop its `<script>` tag. Why: one source for shared characters.
